indicators.title: Credit-to-GDP Gap (BIS, private non-financial sector, Spain)
indicators.source: Bank for International Settlements (BIS), credit-to-GDP gap statistics (BIS Data Portal, SDMX)
indicators.definition: Credit-to-GDP gap for Spain as published by the BIS: total credit to the private non-financial sector from all lenders, percent of GDP, minus its long-run trend (one-sided HP filter, lambda 400,000), percentage points. The Basel III countercyclical capital buffer guide; the same source family as the U.S. pair in the main index.

indicators.title: Debt Service Ratio (BIS, private non-financial sector, Spain)
indicators.source: Bank for International Settlements (BIS), debt service ratio statistics (BIS Data Portal, SDMX)
indicators.definition: Debt service ratio of the Spanish private non-financial sector as published by the BIS: interest payments plus amortisation as a percent of income, percent. Published from 1999Q1.

indicators.title: Deposit Institutions' Capital and Reserves to Total Liabilities (Banco de España)
indicators.source: Banco de España, Boletín Estadístico, table 8.32 (deposit institutions' balance sheet, liabilities)
indicators.definition: 100 x (capital and reserves of Spanish deposit institutions — credit institutions and EFCs, BE_8_32.9) / (their total liabilities, BE_8_32.1), percent, quarter-end month. The balance-sheet leverage counterpart of the U.S. Y-9C equity ratios; oriented so that a thinner capital share reads as more vulnerable.

indicators.title: CET1 Ratio of Spanish Deposit Institutions
indicators.source: Banco de España / ECB supervisory statistics
indicators.definition: Common Equity Tier 1 capital as a percent of risk-weighted assets for Spanish deposit institutions.
indicators.pending_reason: Published in the Banco de España and ECB supervisory statistics portals as report tables; no stable machine-readable public series route was resolved for this build. The balance-sheet capital share above carries the leverage component meanwhile.

indicators.title: Deposit Institutions' Loans to Non-Bank Residents / Deposits of Other Resident Sectors (Banco de España)
indicators.source: Banco de España, Boletín Estadístico, tables 8.33 and 8.34 (deposit institutions' balance sheet)
indicators.definition: 100 x (deposit institutions' loans and credits to non-bank residents in Spain — general government and other resident sectors, BE_8_33.8) / (deposits of other resident sectors at deposit institutions, BE_8_34.7), percent, quarter-end month. The funding gap that defined Spanish bank balance sheets before 2012: a ratio well above 100 means lending funded by wholesale markets and the Eurosystem rather than by deposits. The Banco de España's own stability-report variant, which adds securitised loans back to credit and strips repos from deposits, prints higher; this is the balance-sheet-tables variant, computed from two published aggregates with no adjustment.

indicators.title: Financial Institutions' Total Liabilities to GDP (Banco de España, financial accounts)
indicators.source: Banco de España, Cuentas Financieras de la Economía Española (Boletín Estadístico, tables 2.5 and 2.1)
indicators.definition: 100 x (total liabilities of the financial institutions sector, all instruments, CFEE balance sheet, BE_2_5.2.19, published in thousands of euros) / (nominal GDP, trailing four quarters, BE_2_1.28, millions of euros), percent. The financial-accounts counterpart of the U.S. Z.1 size measures.

indicators.title: Top-5 Banking Groups' Share of System Assets
indicators.source: Banco de España, supervision and financial stability reports
indicators.definition: 100 x (total assets of the five largest Spanish banking groups) / (total assets of the banking system), percent.
indicators.pending_reason: Published in Banco de España supervision and financial stability reports as report tables, not as a downloadable time series; no stable machine-readable public route was resolved for this build.

indicators.title: Housing Loans to Households to GDP (Banco de España)
indicators.source: Banco de España, Boletín Estadístico, tables 8.19 and 2.1
indicators.definition: 100 x (MFI loans to households for house purchase, BE_8_19.15, quarter-end month) / (nominal GDP, trailing four quarters, BE_2_1.28), percent.

indicators.title: Total Credit to Households to GDP (BIS)
indicators.source: Bank for International Settlements (BIS), total credit statistics (BIS Data Portal, SDMX)
indicators.definition: Total credit to Spanish households and NPISH from all lenders (loans and debt securities), percent of GDP, as published by the BIS.

indicators.title: Variable-Rate Share of New Housing Loans
indicators.source: ECB MFI interest rate (MIR) statistics / Banco de España
indicators.definition: 100 x (new housing loans with an initial rate fixation of up to one year) / (all new housing loans), percent. The Spanish mortgage-risk gauge that replaces the U.S. GSE/FICO block: most Spanish mortgages reset off 12-month Euribor, so the fixation share measures how much of the stock reprices within a year of a rate rise.
indicators.pending_reason: The fixation breakdown is published in the ECB MIR statistics and Banco de España new-business volumes; the SDMX key for the Spanish fixation split was not resolved at build time.

indicators.title: Consumer Credit to Households to GDP (Banco de España)
indicators.source: Banco de España, Boletín Estadístico, tables 8.19 and 2.1
indicators.definition: 100 x (MFI consumer credit to households, BE_8_19.11, quarter-end month) / (nominal GDP, trailing four quarters, BE_2_1.28), percent.

indicators.title: Total Credit to Non-Financial Corporations to GDP (BIS)
indicators.source: Bank for International Settlements (BIS), total credit statistics (BIS Data Portal, SDMX)
indicators.definition: Total credit to Spanish non-financial corporations from all lenders (loans and debt securities), percent of GDP, as published by the BIS.

indicators.title: Household Net Financial Saving, Percent of GDP (Banco de España, financial accounts)
indicators.source: Banco de España, Cuentas Financieras de la Economía Española (Boletín Estadístico, table 2.7)
indicators.definition: Households' and NPISH net financial transactions (net acquisition of financial assets minus net incurrence of liabilities) as a percent of GDP, as published by the Banco de España (BE_2_7.7, 'ratio sobre el PIB'). Labelled a proxy: it is the financial-accounts counterpart of the U.S. NIPA net saving rate, not the national-accounts saving rate itself; oriented so that lower (more negative) saving reads as more vulnerable. Spanish households were net borrowers of 5-7% of GDP at the 2007 boom peak and net lenders of nearly 9% in late 2020.

indicators.title: Residential Property Prices, Annual Change (BIS via FRED)
indicators.source: Bank for International Settlements (BIS), residential property price statistics, via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)
indicators.definition: Four-quarter percent change of the BIS nominal residential property price index for Spain. A price-growth gauge: the level of the index trends, so the vulnerability signal is the boom rate, as in the U.S. panel's price measures.

indicators.title: House Price Index, Annual Change (INE)
indicators.source: Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE), Índice de Precios de Vivienda (IPV)
indicators.definition: Annual rate of change of the INE house price index (national, all dwellings), percent, as published. The IPV starts in 2007Q1; earlier quarters are missing values, never back-filled from another index.

indicators.title: House Price to Household Income Ratio (Banco de España)
indicators.source: Banco de España, housing market indicators
indicators.definition: Price of a standard dwelling as a multiple of gross annual household income, as published in the Banco de España housing market indicators.
indicators.pending_reason: Published in the Banco de España housing-market indicators workbook; no stable machine-readable public series route was resolved for this build. The two price-growth gauges above carry the component meanwhile.

indicators.title: Bank Lending Survey: Credit Standards for Enterprises, Spain (ECB)
indicators.source: European Central Bank, Bank Lending Survey (Spain breakdown)
indicators.definition: Net percentage of banks reporting a tightening of credit standards on loans to enterprises in Spain, ECB Bank Lending Survey — the SLOOS counterpart in the U.S. panel.
indicators.pending_reason: The ECB Data Portal serves the Bank Lending Survey under the BLS dataflow; the key for the Spain enterprise-standards question was not resolved at build time. The component ships empty rather than substituting a U.S. or euro-area aggregate.

indicators.title: New-Lending Rate Spread on Loans to Non-Financial Corporations (Banco de España, TEDR)
indicators.source: Banco de España, TEDR interest rate statistics (Boletín Estadístico, chapter 19)
indicators.definition: Average rate on new loans to non-financial corporations (TEDR) minus the matched-maturity euro swap rate, basis points: the price of new business credit.
indicators.pending_reason: The TEDR tables are published in chapter 19 of the Boletín Estadístico; the new-business series codes and a free matched swap benchmark were not both resolved at build time.

indicators.title: MFI Debt Securities Issued to Total Liabilities (Banco de España)
indicators.source: Banco de España, Boletín Estadístico, table 8.3 (MFI balance sheet, liabilities)
indicators.definition: 100 x (debt securities issued by Spanish MFIs, BE_8_3.8) / (total MFI liabilities, BE_8_3.1), percent, quarter-end month: the market-funded share of the balance sheet (cédulas, senior and securitisation bonds).

indicators.title: Net Borrowing from the Eurosystem to Total MFI Liabilities (Banco de España)
indicators.source: Banco de España, Boletín Estadístico, tables 7.3 and 8.3
indicators.definition: 100 x (Banco de España loans and credits to MFIs resident in Spain — monetary-policy lending, BE_7_3.4) / (total MFI liabilities, BE_8_3.1), percent, quarter-end month. The Spanish twist on the U.S. wholesale-funding component: when market funding closed in 2011-12 and again in 2020, the Eurosystem replaced it, so central-bank borrowing is part of the funding-fragility measure, not a separate story.

indicators.title: 10-Year Bono–Bund Spread (OECD via FRED)
indicators.source: OECD long-term interest rates via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)
indicators.definition: Quarterly mean of the monthly spread between the Spanish 10-year government bond yield (IRLTLT01ESM156N) and the German 10-year yield (IRLTLT01DEM156N), in basis points. The price leg of the sovereign–bank nexus: the U.S. index has no counterpart because the Treasury is the safe asset.

indicators.title: MFIs' Holdings of Spanish General Government Debt Securities to Total Assets (Banco de España)
indicators.source: Banco de España, Boletín Estadístico, tables 8.5 and 8.3
indicators.definition: 100 x (debt securities issued by Spanish general government held by MFIs resident in Spain, BE_8_5.6) / (total MFI balance sheet, BE_8_3.1), percent, quarter-end month. The quantity leg of the nexus: how much of the banking system's balance sheet is the sovereign's paper. Loans to government are excluded; this is the securities book that marks to market.

indicators.title: Composite Indicator of Systemic Stress for Spain (ECB CISS)
indicators.source: European Central Bank, Composite Indicator of Systemic Stress (CISS), ECB Data Portal
indicators.definition: Quarterly mean of the daily ECB Composite Indicator of Systemic Stress for Spain (new CISS), index 0-1. A market-price stress composite across money, bond, equity, financial-intermediary and foreign-exchange subindices for Spain specifically — not the euro-area aggregate.

indicators.title: IBEX 35 Earnings / Dividend Yield
indicators.source: Bolsas y Mercados Españoles (BME) / ECB
indicators.definition: Earnings (or dividend) yield of the IBEX 35, percent. No Shiller CAPE exists for Spain; a yield is the available valuation gauge, oriented so that a lower yield (richer pricing) reads as more vulnerable.
indicators.pending_reason: No stable free machine-readable series for an IBEX earnings or dividend yield was resolved at build time (BME publishes index statistics as report files; the ECB does not carry a Spanish earnings yield).

indicators.title: Corporate Bond Spread (euro-area proxy, labelled)
indicators.source: ICE BofA euro-area corporate indices / ECB
indicators.definition: Option-adjusted spread on euro-area corporate bonds, basis points, to be labelled a euro-area proxy on the page: Spain's corporate bond market is too thin for a clean domestic OAS, and Spanish issuers fund at euro-area spreads plus a sovereign-linked premium already measured by the Bono–Bund leg.
indicators.pending_reason: No free machine-readable route for an ICE BofA euro-area OAS was resolved at build time; the series ships pending rather than substituting a U.S. spread.

indicators.title: Commercial Property Prices, Spain (BIS)
indicators.source: Bank for International Settlements (BIS), commercial property price statistics
indicators.definition: Four-quarter percent change of the BIS commercial property price index for Spain.
indicators.pending_reason: The BIS commercial property price dataset is distributed as portal downloads rather than a stable SDMX series for Spain; no free machine-readable route was resolved at build time.
